Name: Zheng Yi
Description: Zheng Yi was a Chinese sorcerer, younger brother of Zheng Zu, with whom he founded the Five Weapons Society, is uncle of Shang-Chi, Brother Sabre, Sister Hammer, Sister Dagger, Brother Staff and Sister Staff. After Yi's death, Zu changed the organization to crime, using names like Si-Fan and The Celestial Order of the Hai-Dai.
